violation_type.title: Activities for Toddlers - Provide Social and Emotional Development (26 TAC §746.2507(7))
violation_type.short_title: Activities for Toddlers - Provide Social and Emotional Development
violation_type.typical_finding: There were no toys available on the shelf in the toddler room.

finding_variants.text: There were no toys available on the shelf in the toddler room.

During the monitor visit, the toddler classroom has shelves but limited toys. The classroom does not have toys available for social-emotional, fine motor, or art activities or manipulatives, and the bookshelf is turned toward the wall.
